verdict.rationale: Extend documents workflow versioning with one editable draft and any number of immutable deployed versions. Processors are the unit you version and iterate on in Studio. Evaluation set runs score a specific processor version, which supports reviewing changes before promotion, and a test API key keeps runs away from production data and webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/redeploy-previous-version documentation, diff or change-review tooling between versions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
